answers.reason: The senate decides on statutes, structure, and strategy of the whole university, not matters of the administration.
Members of the administration work on the budget, but budget planning rounds allocate funds rather than being bodies for administrative staff.
Appointment committees select candidates for vacant professorships, which is not an administrative matter.
Faculty councils decide on the affairs of one faculty, which is outside the scope of general administrative staff bodies.
Examination boards decide on examination matters of individual students, which falls under administrative work on examinations.
